title: Impacted tests
summary: Impacted selection follows ordinary imports, including helper names resolved from indexed package markers under pytest prepend mode. Bare-name collisions conservatively add tests; existing full module edges remain. Single-word dynamic import strings are not dependency evidence. Deleted source paths retain their dotted module identity, so direct, transitive and bounded selection still reach their importers; removed tests are excluded from runnable paths. Each import index resolves declared test roots once from its explicit checkout and carries them into selection, including full-sweep paths. Per-path classification does not read the working directory; changing or deleting it does not change the selected checkout.
